description: The exact credit price of ONE prompt-to-motion clip (generate_motion_clip) BEFORE it is made, and whether this account may start it right now. Read-only: nothing is created, reserved or charged, and no prompt is checked. Returns credits (5 s = 115), the balance, canAfford, canStart and, when it cannot be started, blockedBy (code + message) and a nextAction. The price is the account's own: 115 at the standard price, 50 at the low price, which applies for the credits bought in the last 31 days (an active paid plan period or a credit pack). lowPriceCreditsLeft says how many low-price credits are left; priceWithRecentPayment is present when this quote is at the standard price. Too few credits, clips already in flight and the daily limit show up here. Tell the user the price before you call generate_motion_clip. (quote_video is the other quote: animated scenes of a normal video.) Requires the "video:read" scope. Optional tier: "seedance-2.5-480p" (Seedance 2.5 480p (with sound), 4-30 s, 68 credits per second: 5 s = 340, 15 s = 1020; 30 per second at the low price); "seedance-2.5-720p" (Seedance 2.5 720p (with sound), 4-30 s, 152 credits per second: 5 s = 760, 15 s = 2280; 66 per second at the low price); "wan-3.0-480p" (Wan 3.0 480p (with sound), 2-30 s, 33 credits per second: 5 s = 165, 15 s = 495; 15 per second at the low price); "wan-3.0-720p" (Wan 3.0 720p (with sound), 2-30 s, 66 credits per second: 5 s = 330, 15 s = 990; 29 per second at the low price); "wan-3.0-1080p" (Wan 3.0 1080p (with sound), 2-30 s, 131 credits per second: 5 s = 655, 15 s = 1965; 57 per second at the low price). A tier with sound returns the clip WITH an AI-generated sound track (speech, ambience) and the "no spoken dialogue" suffix is not added. Lip-sync, face swaps and talking avatars (a person talking to the camera) stay refused on every tier, with or without sound. A clip on an optional tier can take up to 30 minutes: keep polling, the credits stay held while it is being made. Without tier the clip is the standard silent one described above. approxUsd is the same price in USD at what a credit costs this account, and approxUsdBasis says how it is worked out.

duration.description: Clip length in whole seconds (default 5). Up to 12 without tier; up to 30 with an optional tier. From 4 without tier; from 2 on a tier that makes shorter clips.

tier.description: Optional. A higher-quality model with sound: seedance-2.5-480p = Seedance 2.5 480p (with sound); seedance-2.5-720p = Seedance 2.5 720p (with sound); wan-3.0-480p = Wan 3.0 480p (with sound); wan-3.0-720p = Wan 3.0 720p (with sound); wan-3.0-1080p = Wan 3.0 1080p (with sound). Omit it (or pass seedance-2.0-mini-480p) for the standard silent clip. A tier with sound costs more per second: quote it first.
